_comment: Role definitions for OnePlatform RBAC. Apply with: op auth roles import --config configs/rbac-roles.json

roles.name: platform-admin
roles.description: Full platform administrator with unrestricted access across all tenants. Can manage tenants, users, plugins, and all platform configuration.

roles.name: tenant-admin
roles.description: Tenant administrator with full access within their own tenant. Can manage users, roles, data sources, pipelines, and apps within the tenant.

roles.name: data-engineer
roles.description: Data engineer role for building and managing data pipelines, connectors, and ontology definitions. Can read and write data, manage pipelines, and deploy plugins.

roles.name: business-analyst
roles.description: Business analyst with read access to data and the ability to build and deploy apps and dashboards. Cannot modify ontology or manage pipelines.

roles.name: viewer
roles.description: Read-only viewer role. Can view data, dashboards, and published apps but cannot modify anything. Suitable for stakeholders and external collaborators.

scopeDefinitions._comment: Reference of all available scopes. This is for documentation purposes and is not processed by the import command.
scopeDefinitions.data:read: Read entity data (records, objects, time series)
scopeDefinitions.data:write: Create, update, and delete entity data
scopeDefinitions.ontology:read: View entity type definitions, relationships, and schemas
scopeDefinitions.ontology:write: Create and modify entity type definitions
scopeDefinitions.pipelines:read: View pipeline definitions and execution history
scopeDefinitions.pipelines:manage: Create, edit, and delete pipeline definitions
scopeDefinitions.apps:manage: Create, edit, and delete application definitions
scopeDefinitions.plugins:read: View installed plugins and their configuration
scopeDefinitions.users:read: View user accounts and role assignments
scopeDefinitions.users:manage: Create, update, and deactivate user accounts
scopeDefinitions.logs:export: Export log data for external analysis
scopeDefinitions.execution:run: Execute code in the sandbox runtime
